distributeReward(bytes32,address,uint256.details: Can only be called by authorized prize pool contracts

params.poolId: Unique identifier for the prize pool claim
params.winner: Address of the winner receiving rewards
params.xpAmount: Amount of XP tokens being claimed

params.token: Address of token to withdraw (address(0) for ETH)

returns.totalUsers: Number of users who received distributions

returns.processed: Whether the claim has been processed

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.caller: Address of the contract to authorize/deauthorize

params._baseRewardRate: USDT per XP token (scaled for USDT decimals)
params._maxRewardPerClaim: Maximum USDT reward per single claim
params._minRewardThreshold: Minimum USDT amount to trigger distribution

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

depositUSDT(uint256).notice: Deposit USDT into the vault for distribution

distributeReward(bytes32,address,uint256.notice: Distribute USDT rewards to winner when they claim XP tokens
